subject: Cripple broken unit test (#221)
reason: The change modifies only unit test files (testing/*.cc and vmsdk/testing/*.cc): it adds EXPECT_CALL mock expectations for GetIdentifier in several gmock-based tests and disables two flaky tests (LogTest.SinkOptions, ThreadPoolTest.priority) behind #ifdef BROKEN_UNIT_TEST. No code that is compiled into the valkey-search module changes, so the module's runtime behaviour is identical on both builds and no scenario can reach the change.
